entry.subject: 北宋中原 护运行/货栈院落（原创扩展；建筑细部待考）
entry.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated production city-map building sprite for tianshu, Northern Song central plains Kaifeng/Luoyang around 1093. Reference images supply only realistic ancient materials and detail density; never copy reference camera mistakes or southern lush vegetation. Historical realistic grey clay tile, warm grey plaster over earth and rough bricks, matte weathered timber; restrained subtle ochre and red where structural. NOT toy, plastic, miniature diorama or ink wash. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, ground axes EXACT slopes +0.5/-0.5 (2:1 dimetric), parallel opposite edges, upright columns, NO perspective. South entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. Entire isolated footprint on one extremely thin flat ground-contact parallelogram with left, bottom/front and right corners clearly visible for grid calibration. Only a shallow masonry contact strip, NO thick plinth. Upper-left screen illumination, short contact shadow towards lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background, at least10% clear margins all sides. All roof ends and ground corners visible. No text, writing, signs, symbols, watermark, people, surrounding city, sky, trees outside footprint, modern objects, Qing ornament, imperial yellow roofs, thick bases or checkerboard. Subject: one unmarked Northern Song cargo depot and caravan escort courtyard, plain grey-tiled warehouse main hall, side covered storage shed containing2 modest bundles and a cart within walls, packed earth court, broad plain wooden gate lower-left. Functional escort/depot appearance is an original game design, not a claim of a historical Song biaoju organization. Footprint14m east-west by11m north-south; front down-right edge / up-right edge ratio14/11. Paper-thin contact parallelogram; no flags, shields, weapon display or modern crates. All background alpha zero, no ambient haze or ground glow. Geometry priority: ground corner targets in1536x1024: LEFT(100,530), FRONT(884,922), RIGHT(1500,614), BACK(716,222). Use these exact relative positions up to uniform scale/translation. Make orthographic parallelogram, each visible ground edge slope magnitude0.5; avoid steep .57 slopes. Do not draw labels. Alter composition: central broad loading hall with large double doors, only one small low cargo shelter at right, no extra private residence hall.
entry.negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、场景背景、厚底座、塑料感、清式重彩、黄琉璃宫顶、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋套件仅材质与写实细节参考；非本图几何或历史准确性背书

entry.created_time_basis: 源PNG文件mtime；非服务端披露调用时间

steps: one uniform LANCZOS resize with integer size rounding
pad RGBA; original alpha preserved; no thresholding, repaint, warp or flip

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工量可见薄底面三角点；后角遮挡推算，非测绘；残差不以几何变形修正

anchor_rounding_correction.reason: 按整数resize后的sx/sy转换，避免requested scale的亚像素偏移；未改图像或底面测点

entry.notes: 已逐张view_image原图与最终PNG自查。第二候选货栈构成更明确，较首图占地比更近；两轴仍偏差。镖局组织与称谓年代待考，本图为原创扩展。单视图；运行时拼接待实测；形制组合为原创扩展，细部待考。
